summary: This file contains two different syntax examples for blocking all access to a directory using Apache's access control rules. The first uses Apache 2.2's older 'Deny' directive, while the second shows the newer 'Require' directive syntax for Apache 2.4 and later. Only one should be uncommented depending on your server version.

explanations.2: This line blocks all incoming requests to this directory and everything in it—think of it as putting up a 'no entry' sign for anyone trying to access these files.
explanations.5: This is the modern Apache 2.4 way to say the same thing as line 2; it's currently commented out (the # at the start) because it would conflict with the active rule above it.
